_comment: Goldens for the learner Agent Chat tools suite: one learner-style prompt per tool.
tool: the tool the agent must call. args: arguments that must be present and right
(same matchers as routing.json: '/re/flags', arrays = membership, else case-insensitive).
run: true = also EXECUTE the tool for the test learner and require no error. Only
read-only tools run; anything that changes data (challenges, messages, tasks, blogs…)
is checked for the right choice and arguments only, never executed.
Ids in prompts are placeholders — the suite checks the agent passes them through.
thresholdNote: A wrong tool in the learner's chat is a wrong action or a wrong answer. One miss in ten is the most a release can carry.
